property_summary: For every admissible call to Collect that actually changes state or when it cannot, the strictly-greater-than unlock-time guard means the reference never allows a state-changing Collect at block.timestamp exactly equal to acc.unlockTime; the bug allows it, which the fuzzer exposes by finding a holder whose balance and unlockTime satisfy the other guards and collecting at the exact unlock time.
change_summary: Change the unlock-time guard from block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime to block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime, allowing collection at the exact unlock time.
